gyro_bias_assumption.assumption: initial window is stationary; IMU alone does not prove this
gyro_bias_assumption.selection: first quiet interval in initial search; offline and assumed stationary, not GT-calibrated

ground_truth_usage: epipolar residual evaluation only, never flow initialization
limits: Feature tracking, not semantic road-user tracking or full VIO
Forward-backward consistency and epipolar residual do not prove exact landmark identity
Wrong gyro sign is a deliberate negative control
Rotation-only initialization ignores translation, rolling shutter and bias/calibration error
